s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic painful intertriginous wounds with granulomatous inflammation
salient_findings: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques
Granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate with well-formed, nonnecrotizing granulomas
key_facts: 1.5-year history of painful intertriginous wounds
History of hypertension and depression
Multiple hospital admissions for cellulitis around the wounds
Received diverting sigmoid colostomy and indwelling urinary catheter
Received adalimumab for 3 months without clinical improvement
Family history of similar condition
Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques in intertriginous areas
Wedge biopsy showed pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia and granulomatous inflammation
Histochemical stains, tissue cultures, and PCR for herpes simplex virus were negative
Elevated immunoglobulin G antibodies and flagellins

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic painful intertriginous wounds with granulomatous inflammation
salient_findings: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques
Granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate with well-formed, nonnecrotizing granulomas
key_facts: 1.5-year history of painful intertriginous wounds
History of hypertension and depression
Multiple hospital admissions for cellulitis around the wounds
Received diverting sigmoid colostomy and indwelling urinary catheter
Received adalimumab for 3 months without clinical improvement
Family history of similar condition
Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques in intertriginous areas
Wedge biopsy showed pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia and granulomatous inflammation
Histochemical stains, tissue cultures, and PCR for herpes simplex virus were negative
Elevated immunoglobulin G antibodies and flagellins

raw.rationale: The presence of nonnecrotizing granulomas, Langhans-type multinucleated giant cells, and epithelioid histiocytes in the biopsy specimen, along with the clinical presentation of intertriginous wounds and systemic symptoms, is consistent with sarcoidosis. The negative results for infectious agents and the lack of response to adalimumab also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: The absence of necrotizing granulomas and the lack of upper respiratory tract involvement make this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: wound
rejected.why: This is a symptom rather than a diagnosis

rejected.label: aa amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of amyloid deposits in the biopsy specimen

rejected.label: tuberculosis
rejected.why: The negative results for mycobacterial cultures and stains make this diagnosis unlikely
